name: Sporthotel Reisch
beschreibung:
Overview

The Reisch – historically known as the Sporthotel Reisch – is a 4-star hotel in the centre of Kitzbühel in Tyrol. It is located at Franz-Reisch-Straße 3, just a few steps from the historic old town, the Hahnenkammbahn railway and exclusive shops, right in the heart of the Gamsstadt. The operators describe the property as a combination of tradition and modern lifestyle: stylishly furnished rooms with mountain views, a vital breakfast and a small, fine wellness area are part of the offering. An à-la-carte restaurant serving Austrian cuisine and the Reisch Bar complete the stay. The hotel sees itself as a meeting place and as the ideal starting point for an active holiday, a ski weekend, a business trip or a romantic getaway – in summer and winter alike.

History/Background

The property was founded by the Kitzbühel ski pioneer Franz Reisch (1863–1920). He established the Sporthotel as his own business in 1910, and it opened in 1912. Franz Reisch is considered the first skier on the Kitzbüheler Horn and the first ski instructor of the Gamsstadt; he played a key role in shaping the emerging winter tourism. His son Ernst Reisch founded the Kitzbüheler Skiclub in 1931, which still exists today. Today the hotel is run by the Mayr-Reisch family. Since 2013, newly designed legend rooms have told the stories of Kitzbühel personalities; in the meantime, 16 rooms have been created from this.

Getting there

By road, the journey – for example coming from Munich – leads via the motorway and the B173 Eiberg Bundesstraße through Söll, Ellmau, Going and St. Johann to Kitzbühel; a vignette is mandatory on Austria's motorways. The hotel is located right next to the town hall. Stopping and parking are prohibited on the road in front of the hotel; parking spaces are available at the hotel – guests should ask about them directly upon arrival. Kitzbühel is easily reachable by train: Kitzbühel Hahnenkamm station is only about 400 metres from the hotel, and Kitzbühel station about one kilometre. From Innsbruck HBF it is around 92 km, from Salzburg HBF around 83 km and from Munich HBF around 128 km. A taxi transfer from the station can be arranged through the hotel.

Tips

Anyone arriving by car should clarify the parking question right at the reception, as the road in front of the building may not be used for parking. For a transfer from the station, a lead time of at least one day is sufficient; an airport transfer from Innsbruck, Salzburg or Munich should be requested at least one week in advance. The central location makes it possible to reach the old town, shops and the Hahnenkammbahn railway comfortably on foot. Culinary highlights include the hotel's own restaurant and the Reisch Bar.

Best time to travel

Kitzbühel is a year-round destination. In winter, the surrounding slopes and the winter sports infrastructure offer the best conditions; in summer, hiking and mountain tours invite visitors into the Kitzbüheler Alpen. The hotel itself names active holidays, ski weekends and relaxation in summer and winter as suitable occasions for a stay.
